steps.label: Cluster assets
steps.sub: group tickers that move alike for diversification

code:
corr = returns.corr()
dist = np.sqrt(0.5 * (1 - corr))

agg = AgglomerativeClustering(
    n_clusters=5,
    metric="precomputed",
    linkage="average",
)
asset_clusters = agg.fit_predict(dist.values)
caption: Correlation is largest for identical behavior, so it is transformed into a true distance before clustering.
